'''Disruption Projectors''' were components used in [[Individual field disruptor/Legends|individual field disruptors]] such as [[Aeramaxis Technologies]]' [[Evasive-13 individual field disruptor|Evasive-13]]. The deflectors were located on the exterior of the device's projection shell.<ref name="EGWT" />
